Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a wallet that he loved very much. One day, he went to the park to play. He left his wallet on the bench and went to play on the swings.
Suddenly, a dog ran up and knocked Timmy off the swing. Timmy fell and hurt his leg. He was very sad and started to cry. The dog ran away and Timmy's mom took him to the police.
Timmy's mom said, "We will look for your wallet, but we will have to pay for it." Timmy didn't like the dog being mean to him. He wanted his wallet back. But his mom said they would have to go home.
At home, Timmy's mom had a dirty wallet for Timmy. Timmy didn't like the dirty wallet, but he didn't say anything. He was very sad. The next day, Timmy went back to the park to play again. But he couldn't find his wallet. He looked everywhere, but it was gone. Timmy cried and wished he never left his wallet on the swing.
